Public Service Broadcast (PSB) Funding and Viewership

Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim: In the Financial Years (FY) 2010 and 2011, Public Service Broadcast (PSB) funding catered for the provision of over 2,000 hours of local productions11 each year, broadcast across MediaCorp's seven free-to-air (FTA) TV channels. This amounted to over 200 programme titles each year.

In terms of the genre composition of PSB-funded local programme hours, about 60% comprise news12 and information programmes, which includes current affairs.

11 PSB funding caters for over 4,000 hours of programmes each year, of which over 2,000 are local productions. The remaining hours are acquired programmes, such as educational and arts/culture programmes, which help to supplement the overall PSB content offering.
12 News programmes receive some PSB funding support, but by and large, MediaCorp is obligated to provide news at its own cost.
